purpose: Provisional skeleton-first S1 superior-endplate/pelvic sagittal frame P1 derived from the retained bilateral hip-joint centres and one internally coherent male standing PTh/PT/SS family.

retained_hip_axis.policy: HJC transverse/vertical placement is retained provisionally because independent pelvic/ANSUR checks support it; this frame may move if the rebuilt acetabular geometry later disproves the retained HJC.

derived_S1_superior_endplate.method: From HA, move PTh posterior and superior so the HA→S1-centre vector is PT degrees posterior of vertical. Orient the S1 superior endplate at SS degrees to horizontal.

semantic_vectors_world.superior_normal_points: anterior (-Y) and superior (+Z), perpendicular to the S1 plate

comparison_to_a003_diagnostic_only.warning: The following a003 points are not definition-identical to the S1 superior-endplate centre and must not be treated as direct errors.
comparison_to_a003_diagnostic_only.reading: P1 places S1 centre near the independently plausible sacral/SI vertical region while materially changing its sagittal position. This supports rebuilding the lumbar-sacral frame rather than preserving the mesh-fit a003 endpoint chain.
